segments.rationale: HOOK 1/2 — the sharpest thesis line in the intro block ('nobody talks about the boring part'), face centered and readable in under a second; entered at the breath boundary src 24.8 so no word is clipped; snap-zoom 0.9 on frame 0 because the hook is the one place intensity goes to the top of the range.

HOOK 2/2 — the promise line that frames the top-3, giving two shots inside the first 2.0s before any title card; cut at 0.9s on the bed's first downbeat; punch-in 0.8 tightens on the promise and varies the neighbor move.

No-context setup for point 01 ('most people quit right before it compounds') — the minimum framing a cold viewer needs; entered on the exhale at src 61.4; slow-push 0.3 is the subtle talking-head move that keeps a 2.8s hold intentional without drifting off the face.

POINT 01 statement — chapter change at 4.8s, the first of the three numbered beats; cut on the bed downbeat and on the consonant boundary at src 68.0; handheld 0.25 adds presence under the claim, and the vignette hit lands here (see effectSpecs).

Jump cut that deletes the filler ('you know, like, sort of') between src 71.2 and 74.5 — the 0.9s emphatic clause is all that survives; entered at the audioEnergy dip after the breath; punch-in 0.5 snaps the stress word closer, a pattern interrupt 3.2s into phase 1.

Point 01 payoff/example — the longest hold of phase 1 (4.1s) placed right after the 0.9s insert so the rhythm breathes; cut at src 82.0 on the start of the illustrative sentence; slow-push 0.35 creeps in across the whole explanation.

Point 01 close plus the spoken bridge into point 02 ('second thing, and this one's quieter') — closes the first 12-15s block on schedule; pull-back 0.3 releases the section and signals a chapter is ending.

POINT 02 statement opens the second block — chapter change at exactly 15.0s, on the bed downbeat, keeping the one-point-every-12-15s cadence; the tangent between src 98.3 and 148.2 is dropped whole; drift-right 0.3 re-frames the new argument and breaks the pull-back.
The second half of point 02's claim ('you need more reps') — jump cut removes the restart at src 152; punch-in 0.55 lands on the word 'reps', the emphasis of the whole point.

Tightest shot of phase 2 (0.7s) — two filler-free words kept from a 4s ramble; entered on the audioEnergy dip at src 160.5; whip-shake 0.5 settles in 0.25s so it is safe to cut out of, and it is the pattern interrupt that opens the dense run.
Point 02's supporting clause — the argument stays in source order so the logic reads unbroken despite the jump cuts; slow-push 0.3 contrasts the whip-shake next to it.

The edit's single speed ramp, placed on a wordless 1.0s breath-and-gesture pause (src 172.0-173.0) so no syllable is touched: ramps up into the gesture peak at 172.35 and eases back out, compressing dead air to 0.8s and slingshotting the payoff line. pitchCorrection true keeps the voice natural; duration = 1.0s source / 1.25 average speed.
Point 02 payoff, arriving straight out of the ramp — the ramp-out at 21.8s is the trigger for the brightness hit; punch-in 0.6 punches the conclusion closer.
Counterpoint clause that finishes the 'advice vs reps' contrast; jump cut skips the 5s tangent at src 181-186; drift-left 0.3 mirrors the earlier drift-right for variety.
Short 1.3s connector inside the dense phase-2 run; entered on the breath at src 193.2; breathe 0.25 keeps a static frame alive without a zoom that would fight the neighboring drift.
Point 02's closing sentence, the one 2.0s hold that gives phase 2 shape before the bridge; slow-push 0.35 leans into the wrap.
Bridge into the final point ('into the last one, which is the hardest one') — sets up the music drop 1.6s before it happens; pull-back 0.3 opens the frame so the drop has somewhere to land.

POINT 03 — chapter change at 30.0s where the 21 Savage bed hard-stops, so the voice arrives naked; snap-zoom 0.85 is the 'moment the music breaks' move, and the contrast hit lands on this same frame (see effectSpecs).
The final point's claim, delivered a cappella; 1.1s phase-3 shot length; punch-in 0.6 stresses 'nobody's watching you work'.
0.8s jump cut removing the 'um, I mean' restart at src 275-277.5; whip-shake 0.45 marks the interrupt and settles before the cut out.
The reasoning clause ('exactly why the invisible reps count') — keeps the final point self-contained for a viewer with no prior context; slow-push 0.3 steadies the argument.
Stress-word insert at the audioEnergy peak on 'count' (src 286.0) — the trigger for the saturation hit; punch-in 0.5 doubles the emphasis without a heavy effect on the face.
Phase-3 density continues at 1.3s; the aside at src 288-290 is cut out; handheld 0.25 keeps the a-cappella section from feeling frozen.
0.9s cutaway-free insert on the turn of the sentence; entered at the breath at src 295.8; drift-right 0.3 varies the neighbor after handheld.
The instruction line of the final point ('do the boring rep twice') — the practical takeaway a first-time viewer keeps; punch-in 0.65 is the strongest move of phase 3 short of the hook.
Short 0.9s beat that lets the instruction sit before the thesis returns; breathe 0.25 holds the face without a hard zoom.
Thesis restated, the payoff of the whole 45s — 1.7s, slightly longer than its neighbors so the line can finish; slow-push 0.4 carries it into the landing; vignette hit at 39.8s frames the sentence.

LANDING — the episode's own closing sentence used as the outro so the edit lands instead of trailing off; 3.5s is the longest hold in the cut and the only shot longer than 3.5s of phase 1's 4.1s payoff aside; pull-back 0.35 eases out of the frame on the final word, still a cappella.

Numbered top-3 marker 1, punched in on the 4.8s chapter change with the vignette hit — the numeral does the counting so the caption track can stay verbatim speech. Ends before the 8.0s cut.
Numbered top-3 marker 2 on the 15.0s chapter change, coincident with the sfx impact and the tonal hit; 'drop' animation varies the preset from marker 1.

Numbered top-3 marker 3 at 30.0s. Deliberate template override to white: the accent yellow belonged to the music-backed sections, and the colour change plus the missing bed signals the final point is the intimate one.

Same grade spec as every other anchor shot — one treatment for the whole edit, not a per-shot look; carries phase 1's setup.
Identical grade on the phase-1 payoff hold so the 4.1s shot matches the hook and the point statement exactly.
Identical grade across the bridge shot — keeps the seam between point 01 and point 02 invisible.
Grade continues into phase 2's dense run so the acceleration reads as cutting, not as a style change.
Same spec, phase 2 counterpoint shot — coherence across the runtime thirds.
Same spec on the point-02 wrap hold.
Same spec on the bridge into the final point, so the only change at 30.0s is the missing music.
Grade carries into phase 3 — the a-cappella section keeps the identical look, which is what makes the music drop feel like an editorial decision rather than a different video.
Same spec on the takeaway line.
Same spec on the pre-landing beat, closing the grade chain that runs hook to landing.

captionTemplate.rationale: Single template for all 15 open captions: word-by-word karaoke reveal keeps the burn-in locked to the speaker's delivery, heavy black stroke holds legibility over the graded frame, y=0.74 stays above the Shorts caption/UI zone and below the face band. metadata.genre: educational podcast short — talking-head teach, numbered top-3
metadata.rationale: One clear idea (consistency beats intensity) delivered as a numbered top-3 from podcast #1.mp4. Spine: 0.0-2.0 two-shot cold-open hook (thesis line + the promise of three), 2.0-4.8 no-context setup, POINT 01 at 4.8-13.0, bridge 13.0-15.0, POINT 02 at 15.0-28.4, bridge 28.4-30.0, POINT 03 at 30.0-45.0 with the music dropped entirely and a 3.5s held landing. Point spacing 4.8 / 15.0 / 30.0 = roughly one point every 12-15s as requested. All 28 cuts are hard cuts — transitions[] is intentionally EMPTY because the request explicitly forbids transitions. Every cut lands on a breath/consonant boundary (audioEnergy dip) so no word is truncated and the speaker's original wording survives exactly; picture and audio cut together because the request demands jump cuts plus captions synced to speech (a J/L offset would desync the burn-ins). Rhythm: phase 1 avg 2.14s (7 shots), phase 2 avg 1.50s = 70% (10 shots), phase 3 avg 1.36s = 64% overall and 1.15s = 54% across the 10-shot body before the 3.5s landing hold, which is longer than any earlier shot. Look: ONE coherent grade (colorGrade contrast 1.10 / saturation 1.05 / brightness 1.02) reused verbatim on 12 anchor shots across all three phases — warm-neutral podcast contrast, no per-shot styling. All 8 accent hits are grade-family only (brightness, vignette, tonal, contrast, saturation, grain) because this is a face-forward talking head: no glitch, no aberration, no blur on the speaker. Hits escalate 0.5 -> 0.9 intensity across phases and each is triggered by the hook beat, a numbered-point chapter change, the post-ramp payoff, or the music drop. Audio: 21 Savage 'a lot' bed at 0.18 from 0.0-30.0 (low under dialogue per request, overriding the default 0.6-0.8 bed level), hard-stopped at 30.0 so the final point plays a cappella; three low 808 slices from the same file act as impacts on the hook and the two chapter changes. 19 text elements: 1 hook callout, 3 big numerals, 15 continuous open captions covering 0.0-45.0 with zero gaps, each sized to >= words/3 reading time at ~2.6 words/sec so they read as verbatim speech; captions sit at y=0.74 (clear of the bottom 20% UI) and numerals at y=0.16 (clear of the top 10%), never over the face band.
